displayName: App Check verification rejections spike (>50 / 5 min)

documentation.content: Firebase App Check is denying an unusually high number of token verifications on ko-lernen-app. Could mean a client build is shipping a stale/invalid attestation, an App Check provider (Play Integrity / DeviceCheck) misconfiguration, or an attack. First checks: docs/runbooks/ops-alerts.md#02. Metric: firebaseappcheck.googleapis.com/services/verification_count, label result=DENY (verified live against ko-lernen-app on 2026-09-14).
